The following strings are approved on crowdin but untranslated ingame :

- "World Stores" (138349)

- "Group Stores" (138357)

- "Price:" (138225)

- "{0} with" (138299)

- "{0} days left" (138303) and probably the associated strings (hours, minutes, etc.)

The following strings are not available for translation : 

- "Featured World Stores" in the World Stores tab of the Shop

- "Discover and support world creators. Access unique content and experience available only inside their worlds" in the World Stores tab of the Shop

- All of the names of the rows in the Avatars tab of the Shop (New, Human, etc...)

- The tag "Portal" shown next to the name of the product in the Shop (see screen 1) 

- Names and descriptions of the products in the Exclusive tab of the Shop (L1-V3 Portal, Candy Codex, Spookality Bundle, etc...)

- "Premium Emoji" and "Premium Stickers" seen on the products in the Exclusive tab of the Shop (see screen 2)

- "Live Now" tab and tooltips in the Main and Quick Menu

- The Marketplace (Shop ?) tooltip of the tab in the Quick and Main Menu

- "Select" button in the QM

comments.mergedPostTitle: Untranslated strings in the Avatar marketplace

details:
The following screenshots showcase a lack of translation because of Missing Crowdin Strings:

Screenshot 1.

Missing Crowdin Strings in Launch Pad after new update leading to untranslated "Shop" Button, "Exclusive content now available in the Shop" yellow pop-up above button and "Purchase content from the official VRChat store and from the community." Tooltip.

Screenshot 2.

Missing Crowdin Strings for Sections within the new Shop "World Stores" and "Group Stores", Bottom Section of the Main Menu also untranslated for the "Shop" Section, including its tooltip which has already been mentioned on Screenshot 1, Product Type Names "Companion", "Premium Stickers" and "Premium Emoji", days left indicator "23 days left" & "with" present on pricing for VRC+ Users.

Screenshots 3, 4, 5 & 6.

Missing Crowdin Strings for Types of Marketplace/Shop Avatars available for purchase including "Popular (Weekly)", "New", "Branded Characters", "Anime", "Furry and Animal Friends", "Cartoony", "Sci-Fi and Fantasy", "Human" and "Marketplace A-Z".

Screenshot 7.

Missing Crowdin Strings within the World Stores Title "Featured World Stores" and description "Discover and support world creators. Access unique content and experiences available only inside their worlds."

Screenshot 8.

Missing Crowdin Strings within the Group Stores, this time the title "Featured Group Stores" and description "Subscribe to groups to unlock exclusive content and help creators build better worlds, events and experiences."

Screenshot 9 & 10.

Missing Crowdin Strings for pricing of Shop Items leading to untranslated texts: "Price: FREE", "Price: V800 I V720 with VRC+" and tooltip for gifting Shop Items "Gift to a friend!".
title: A Second List of Missing Crowdin Strings
